'''Edric Darius''' was the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Tallaan)|Torpedo Sphere]] stationed near [[Tallaan]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His first officer was [[Geffen]].<ref name="LOTE" />
